presentation.label: Actual Axocoatl 1.5 required-review task, recorded in dark mode
presentation.disclosure: Prepared Node invoice-validation fixture. This is a new actual local run, not a replay or rerun of the historical 1.1 benchmark. Two requests are shown. Selected recorded waits are accelerated 12x, repeated waiting and a rejected late-guidance interval are cut, and unrecorded gaps are removed. No synthetic UI or motion interpolation. The first reviewer approval missed a real regression; independent inspection led to a corrective request.

task.request: Tighten invoice input validation while preserving valid totals and existing tests; reject invalid price and quantity representations and add regression coverage. Run npm test, inspect the diff, and do not commit.

outcome.first_case: FAILED: first approval missed removal of the finite-price guard.
outcome.final_case: ACCEPTED: the follow-up restored the guard; required host checks and review approved, with independent artifact checks passing.
outcome.receipt: Native workbench Session; no loadout receipt.

interventions_observed: After first required review approved, independent artifact inspection found the removed finite-price guard. A second dashboard request asked to restore it and add a regression.

The second turn temporarily wrote literal plus prefixes in source. Later attempted UI guidance was rejected as stale/closed; the completed artifact was already corrected. No causal credit is assigned to that rejected guidance.

No product source change was made.
evidence_limits: Prepared small fixture, not a production repository or comparative benchmark.
The first required review missed a real regression; a passing review and configured tests do not establish correctness.

Private raw runtime responses are retained separately; public observations are projections hashed against those source bytes, not cryptographically authenticated server attestations.

encoding.frames: All retained original samples, chronological; privacy or editorial omissions declared; repeated frames only, no interpolation or generated UI.
